goal: Build the exact-revision v0.92 demo, AEE, and proof-coverage index and make unsupported coverage fail closed.
required_outcome: The demo matrix, feature coverage table, activation ledger, and AEE artifact index agree on commands, owners, revisions, platform posture, positive and negative artifacts, review state, and non-claims.
task_boundary: Reconcile and validate v0.92 demo/AEE proof metadata after #5836, #5837, #5838, and #5839; do not implement child features, absorb WP-21/WP-21A reduction work, or declare milestone release readiness.
plan_summary: Verify dependency revisions; correct stale WP-20 ownership while preserving WP-21/WP-21A; replace candidate rows only with accepted exact-revision evidence; build the AEE artifact index; add fail-closed coverage validation; resolve exact-head review.
review_scope: Review the WP-20 matrix, coverage table, activation ledger, AEE index, validator proof, and exact candidate paths for exact-revision traceability, ownership consistency, negative/platform coverage, and unsupported milestone claims.
operator_constraints: Accepted proof requires an exact revision and independently usable artifact
Planned, blocked, failed, synthetic, or receipt-only evidence cannot satisfy coverage
WP-21 and WP-21A retain repository-reduction ownership
Release the preparation claim before implementation handoff

authority_boundary: WP-20 owns integrated demo, AEE, and proof-index truth
Child issues own their feature behavior and primary evidence
WP-23/WP-30 own final quality and release decisions
initial_assumptions: Current coverage prose contains a stale WP-20 reduction assignment
Platform and credential limitations remain explicit row data

deliverables: Reconciled demo matrix and feature coverage table
Fail-closed coverage validator and focused tests
non_goals: Feature implementation or rerouting child ownership
Milestone quality, publication, or release approval

invariants: Every accepted row names an exact revision, command, artifact, owner, and review state
Positive evidence never substitutes for a required negative lane
Platform-specific evidence is not generalized silently
AEE uncertainty is recorded as a blocker, not relabeled as proof
risks: Dependency proof may be incomplete or superseded
Stale ownership prose may conflict with the live wave
Coverage rows may overstate platform or AEE support
stop_conditions: A required dependency lacks accepted exact-revision evidence
WP-20 ownership cannot be reconciled without changing the live wave
A claimed artifact cannot be independently inspected

acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Matrix, coverage, activation-ledger, and artifact-index rows agree on owner, command, status, and exact revision.
AC-2: Every accepted demo/AEE claim has positive artifact, required negative artifact, platform/credential posture, review state, and non-claims.
AC-3: WP-20 demo/proof ownership is corrected without absorbing WP-21/WP-21A reduction work.
AC-4: The validator rejects missing paths, duplicate ownership, planned-as-passed status, synthetic proof, and unsupported platform claims.
AC-5: Exact-head review has no unresolved actionable finding.

steps.action: Verify #5836, #5837, #5838, and #5839 at accepted exact revisions
Reconcile matrix, coverage, activation, and AEE index rows
Correct WP-20 ownership while preserving WP-21/WP-21A
Implement and run positive, negative, and platform coverage checks

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove exact-revision parity across matrix, coverage, activation, and AEE index rows.
Reject missing artifacts, duplicate owners, planned-as-passed, synthetic proof, and unsupported platform claims.
Prove clean patch structure before exact-head review.

review_prompts: Does every accepted row resolve to a current exact revision, command, artifact, owner, and review?
Are negative and platform limits explicit instead of inferred from positive proof?
Does the patch correct stale WP-20 ownership without taking WP-21/WP-21A scope?
Can any planned, synthetic, receipt-only, or historical artifact be mistaken for accepted feature proof?
